sources.title: ruri-coreml/ruri_coreml at main · masahiroid/ruri-coreml - GitHub
sources.snippet: ruri_coreml_convert Converts cl-nagoya/ruri-v3 (a Japanese ModernBERT-based sentence embedding model) to Core ML for on-device use on iOS/macOS, and prepares everything an app needs to bundle it: the .mlpackage, a local tokenizer folder, and a Hugging Face model card.
